issue: Exact duplicate postings (every field equal except s_no)
treatment: Dropped (the only rows deleted in the whole pipeline)

issue: Near-duplicates after normalisation (same clean title, skills, city, experience and salary band; repost with another description)
treatment: Flagged is_near_duplicate; excluded from demand counts

issue: Possible reposts (same clean title, skills, city and experience, but a different salary band)
treatment: Flagged possible_repost only - kept in the sample (salary differs, may be a genuinely separate vacancy); used as a sensitivity check

issue: job_desig: non-ASCII characters / leading-trailing / repeated spaces
treatment: Normalised

issue: job_description: non-ASCII characters / leading-trailing / repeated spaces
treatment: Normalised

issue: key_skills: non-ASCII characters / leading-trailing / repeated spaces
treatment: Normalised

issue: job_description uses ';-' as bullet separators
treatment: Converted to sentences

issue: Designations padded with recruiting noise ('Urgent Hiring', 'Walk-in', 'Opening for', '@Mumbai', bracketed notes)
treatment: Stripped into job_title_clean (original kept in job_desig)

issue: Experience stored as text ('6-10 yrs')
treatment: Parsed to exp_min / exp_max / exp_mid / exp_range_width (years)

issue: Salary only available as 6 text bands ('10to15')
treatment: Ordinal salary_band_ord 1-6, band low/high/mid (LPA), high_pay_15plus (target)

issue: Unparseable or inverted experience ranges
treatment: None found

issue: Lowest band (0-3 LPA) with 8+ years minimum experience - likely undisclosed salary coded as lowest band
treatment: Flagged salary_exp_inconsistent; excluded from salary models

issue: Very wide experience ranges (more than 8 years between min and max)
treatment: Kept; exp_mid used with care

issue: job_type: one value spelt 5 ways (Analytics, analytics, ANALYTICS, analytic, Analytic)
treatment: Merged to 'analytics'

issue: job_type missing for 76% of the original rows (12,011 of 15,841); 78% after removing exact duplicates - not usable as a classifier
treatment: Original column kept unchanged + job_type_tagged (0/1); analytics relevance re-derived from title + skills

issue: location: 1,355 distinct strings, 16% list several cities, variants (Bangalore/Bengaluru, Gurgaon/Gurugram, Mumbai Suburbs, Sohna Road, Hyderabad/Secunderabad), states instead of cities, 'Anywhere Inindia'
treatment: Tokenised; 100+ variants mapped to canonical cities / metro areas; states and 'anywhere' -> Anywhere in India; derived primary_city, cities, n_cities, is_multi_city, city_tier

issue: Overseas locations (Dubai, Canada, US, Singapore, Nigeria, Sweden, New Jersey ...) in an India dataset
treatment: Flagged is_international; excluded from the India market sample

issue: key_skills free text: 8,462 distinct tokens after lower-casing
treatment: Lower-cased, trimmed, trailing '...' removed, synonym map (ML->machine learning, PowerBI->power bi, Base SAS->sas ...), de-duplicated per posting

issue: Spelling/format variants of the same skill (power bi/powerbi, big data/bigdata, javascript/java script, c / c++ ...)
treatment: Auto-merged by letters-only key to the most frequent spelling

issue: Junk skill tokens (empty, numbers like '1120', stray quotes, whole sentences > 45 chars, single letters)
treatment: Removed

issue: Non-skill tokens mixed into skills: education (MBA, B.Com, B.Tech), job meta (fresher, BPO, non voice, present job), soft skills
treatment: Separated into education_mentioned, job_meta_tags, soft_skills; 'skills' keeps technical/domain skills only

issue: key_skills truncated with '...' (87%) - lists are incomplete
treatment: Flagged; supplemented by skills found in the description (skills_from_desc)

issue: 10,097 distinct free-text designations
treatment: Ordered keyword rules on job_title_clean (skills used when the title is uninformative) -> 18 role families + 'Other'; non-analytics guards (RCM, BPO, HR, SEO, IT) run before the generic 'analyst' rule; seniority (5 levels)

issue: Non-analytics roles inside 'Analytics Jobs' (software, BPO, HR, sales, finance, medical coding ...)
treatment: Flagged is_analytics_role=0; core analytics sample uses the 9 analytics families

issue: Low-quality 'data entry / work from home / part-time / freelance' postings
treatment: Flagged is_spam; excluded

issue: job_description missing (3,508 in the original file; count shown is after removing exact duplicates)
treatment: Not imputed (text); flagged desc_missing

issue: job_description truncated with '...'
treatment: Flagged desc_truncated; text treated as partial

issue: Skills recovered from job_description using a 488-skill vocabulary built from key_skills
treatment: skills_from_desc + union skills_all (descriptions also truncated, so a lower bound)

issue: No common key between the 4 files
treatment: Built a 5-dimension skill taxonomy (big data, maths-stats, coding, AI-ML, dashboards-storytelling) matching the JDS scores; each posting flagged dim_* - this is the bridge for linking market demand to the JDS success data

issue: Tool flags must catch compound skills ('Oracle SQL', 'SQL Server', 'SAS SQL', 'MS Excel')
treatment: has_* and dim_* use whole-word matching inside each skill (taxonomy.has), with exclusions such as 'medical coding'

issue: Manual audit of role_family on a final independent random sample of 150 postings
treatment: Exact family correct ~91%; analytics vs non-analytics split correct ~92%. Residual errors are ambiguous titles (e.g. 'SOC Analyst', 'Investment Analyst - Real Estate'); reported as a limitation

issue: reference_no is not unique: 134 numbers shared by 276 different rows
treatment: Kept original as reference_no; new surrogate key row_id (1..n) used as the record key

issue: company_name leading/trailing/double spaces
treatment: Trimmed

issue: Same employer group listed under two names (BNP Paribas / bnp paribas india solutions; HSBC / Hsbc Technology) - the units post the same titles with DIFFERENT salaries and openings, so they are separate listings
treatment: Kept as separate companies (not merged); linked through new company_group column

issue: Placeholder / non-company employer names (Confidential, Xyz Company, Data Entry, Freelancer.com, Freelance Consultants)
treatment: Flagged is_placeholder_employer; excluded from company-level analysis

issue: Salaries stored as text with an 'L' suffix ('7.8L')
treatment: Parsed to numeric lakhs per annum (LPA)

issue: Rule min <= avg <= max salary
treatment: 0 violations - internally consistent

issue: Minimum salary below 1 LPA (e.g. 0.2L = Rs 20,000 a year) - likely monthly/stipend figures entered as annual
treatment: Flagged min_salary_implausible; min salary not used in modelling for these rows (avg/max kept)

issue: Very wide salary range (max more than 6x min)
treatment: Flagged wide_salary_range; avg salary used as the main measure

issue: 'Senior' titles asking for 0 years minimum experience
treatment: Flagged senior_zero_exp (title/experience inconsistency)

issue: num_of_jobs extremely right-skewed (median 22, max 4,200 = TCS Business Analyst); 3xIQR rule
treatment: Genuine bulk hiring - kept; flagged and log-transformed (log_num_jobs) for models

issue: Average salary far from its job title's typical range (robust z > 3 within title, e.g. Flipkart Senior DS 82 LPA)
treatment: Kept (top employers pay more); flagged; salary_lpa_w = winsorised copy for models

issue: min_experience above 12 years (max 21)
treatment: All are Data Architect rows - plausible; kept

issue: Column name with a hyphen ('maths-stats_skills') - invalid in SAS/SQL
treatment: Renamed maths_stats_skills

issue: id not unique: 2 ids shared by different people (different scores)
treatment: Kept as different people; surrogate row_id used as key

issue: Skill scores outside the documented 1-5 scale
treatment: None found

issue: Target salary_hike_high not 0/1
treatment: None; class balance 53% high / 47% low (balanced)

issue: Missing values
treatment: None

issue: Ceiling effect - share of perfect 5.0 scores: big_data 18%, maths_stats 41%, coding 45%, ai_and_ml 49%, dashboard_and_storytelling 58%
treatment: Kept (real scores); handled with rank tests, tree models and n_skills_at_max

issue: Low outliers (|z| > 2.5)
treatment: Kept - genuine weak scores, scale is bounded

issue: Derived profile variables
treatment: skill_mean, skill_min, skill_range, n_skills_at_max, weakest/strongest skill (no composite indices or segments: the 5 scores are used directly)

issue: Column names with stray spaces (' extraversion', 'success_ classification_ high_low')
treatment: Trimmed; target renamed success_high

issue: id not unique: 9 ids shared by different people
treatment: Kept; surrogate row_id used as key

issue: Trait scores outside a plausible 0-100 normalised range
treatment: None (observed 17-68)

issue: Missing values
treatment: None

issue: Target success_high balance
treatment: 53% high / 47% low (balanced)

issue: Trait outliers (|z| > 2.5)
treatment: Kept - extreme but valid personality scores

issue: Derived variables
treatment: z-scores per trait, emotional_stability_z (= -neuroticism_z), trait_mean (positive traits), dominant_trait (highest z among emotional stability and the 4 positive traits)
